seo.titulo: Logos, products and AI cutouts in client clips | Clipfine
seo.descripcion: Add up to 3 images per clip: the client's product, a logo or a person cut out with AI and a sticker outline. For agencies that edit clips for clients.

bajada: A photo, a logo or a cut-out person on top of the video, at the second you choose. AI removes the background and a white outline makes it pop. No other app needed.

d1.que: per clip, each with its own timing

d2.que: to remove the background with AI

agencia.hastaTres: Show the client's product or sponsor right when it's mentioned, without sending the clip to another editor.
agencia.quitarFondo: A cutout that used to be a designer's job is done in the same editor, in seconds.
agencia.contorno: The sticker look that works on TikTok and Reels, with no templates or extra software.

p1.p: Can I show a sponsor's product in the clip?
p1.r: Yes. Upload the photo, drop it on the preview, place it and choose the second it appears and leaves. Up to 3 images per clip.

p2.p: Do I need Photoshop to cut out a person?
p2.r: No. With one tap, AI removes the image's background and you can use it as a cutout, with or without a white outline.

p3.p: Do the images show up in the final video?
p3.r: Yes. They're burned into the MP4 that gets published and the one you download, in the place and at the time you chose.
